answer: Fingerprint the answering model, not the address. The node hashes tokenizer and response cadence, then requires that fingerprint to survive a mirror run through a second provider. Every unverified claim shaves weight; a claim nobody can reproduce counts zero. Five hundred accounts on one model give one fingerprint and one payout, so the voyage through a proxy farm gains nothing. Idle two epochs and standing decays, so a river of parked clones bleeds out.
